# Random Game — Tokyo

> A Tokyo train station drinking game. Roll the dice, ride the rails, explore the city. Bilingual English / 日本語 single-page web app.

## How to play
- Pick a starting Tokyo train station (GPS, search, or random).
- Roll a die to pick a train line and direction.
- Roll again to pick how many stops to ride.
- Along the way, roll at each transfer station to decide whether to switch lines, stay on, or get off and drink.
- Arrive at the destination, grab a drink, and roll again from there.

## About
- Single-page web app at [randomgame.tokyo](https://randomgame.tokyo/).
- No login, no tracking, no ads, no audio.
- Offline-capable PWA (service worker + cached train data).
- Covers the greater Tokyo area. Optimized for the 23 wards but works throughout the Kanto region.
- Uses real train line data: local / semi-express / express / rapid / limited-express services, through-running connections, and schedule-aware stop patterns (e.g. weekend vs weekday).
